# DuckDuckGo AutoConsent

ViperCapture vendors the unmodified browser bundle and full rule bundle from
`@duckduckgo/autoconsent` 16.11.0. Upstream source:
https://github.com/duckduckgo/autoconsent

AutoConsent is licensed under MPL-2.0. The upstream license is included in
`LICENSE`. ViperCapture loads these unmodified assets only when a request asks
for consent cleanup; the surrounding ViperCapture source remains MIT-licensed.
